thread.title: Stock futures indicate tenative gains ahead of 9/11 remembrances

author: Ken Martin
title: Stock futures indicate tenative gains ahead of 9/11 remembrances
text:
Tech stocks drive stock market higher By Leia Klingel Published September 11, 2018 Markets FOXBusiness
 video Trucking stocks lifted Dow Jones transportation index to an all-time high: Charles Payne FBN’s Charles Payne discusses how trucking stocks pushed the Dow Jones transportation index to an all-time high.
The major U.S. stock market indexes accelerated their gains Tuesday afternoon, boosted by the tech sector. The afternoon advance came after a lower open.
Tuesday’s afternoon advance was being propelled by gains in Apple and Microsoft.
Ticker Security Last Change %Chg AAPL APPLE INC. 223.72 +5.39 +2.47% MSFT MICROSOFT CORP. 111.22 +1.84 +1.68% Meanwhile, earlier pressure came following headlines that China will ask the World Trade Organization next week for permission to impose sanctions on the United States.

Shares of airlines, home improvement centers and insurance companies may be active as Hurricane Florence remains on track to make landfall near the Carolina coast later this week.
Commodities were mixed but oil was higher as Hurricane Florence moved toward the U.S. East Coast,
FOX Business' Ken Martin contributed to this article.
